name: ABV ENGINEERS AND CONSULTANTS PVT LTD
india_angle: ABV Engineers & Consultants Pvt Ltd operates in India, focusing on sales and support for various engineering and automation products.
summary: ABV Engineers & Consultants Pvt Ltd is involved in the sales of press safety products, press room automation, and forging machinery, primarily serving industrial sectors. They also engage in trading and installation of engineering products, with a focus on the Indian market.
